whatAContractIs: One page. It freezes a claim before it is measured so the measurement cannot be reshaped to fit, and gives a fresh clone a fixed target. Anything that does not let someone say 'you are wrong, here is the evidence' does not belong in it. Receipts carry command, number, and the digest of evidence that was actually replayed; nothing else.
baseline: eca1704; workspace 683 green; kernel telemetry 4c07c56: 30 parse lanes stop on two __attribute__ lines, 16 preprocess lanes are E0104 (Day 16)
scope: A attributes: parse in every GNU position, attach by position, preserve losslessly; apply only aligned and packed, to layout, checked against the GCC/Clang layout oracle
B publication: a tracked script runs reconnaissance under the pinned observer and writes per-lane counts with the command beside each number; refuses to write on any lane regression
C typeof, _Generic, statement expressions, designated initializers, compound literals
D known-bits lattice, two-tier bounded scheduler, certificate evp2 with premises recomputed by the checker

E kernel parse blockers measured after typeof: __builtin_expect, __builtin_constant_p, __alignof__ (front-end resolved, spec 10.1.14) and the pointer-declarator attribute position (preserved, not applied)

F kernel parse blockers measured after E: __builtin_{add,sub,mul}_overflow (10.1.15) and GNU asm incl. asm goto and asm labels (10.1.16), both front-end complete and fail-closed in lowering; _Static_assert codes migrate to E2911/E2912

G core C debt measured after F: pointer updates (++, --, +=, -= on pointers) and memory places rooted at a loaded pointer value (p->next->v, s.next->v, (*pp)->v, **pp), full lowering with proofs; no not-covered-dayN message may remain

P preprocessor target profile (spec 10.4): sealed GCC-14 predefined macros, __COUNTER__, __has_attribute/__has_builtin/__has_feature/__has_include with measured answers, _Pragma; gate: no raw lane stops on E0104 "Unknown compiler"; where they stop next is counted, not predicted

P2 preprocessor defects measured after P: #if evaluation of pasted pp-numbers (CAT(300,), CAT(0x1,00); suffixed literals already correct); #pragma pack(N)/pack()/push/pop applied to record layout (spec 10.4)

I compile-time builtins and small GNU forms (spec 10.1.17): __builtin_choose_expr, __builtin_types_compatible_p, __builtin_offsetof, bit builtins, __builtin_unreachable, __builtin_return_address, __auto_type, ?:, case ranges, __label__

P3 preprocessor: a ## result is any C11 preprocessing token including pp-numbers (1_MODULE, 1x, 1.5); E0111 only when such a pp-number is consumed by #if (spec 10.4). Gate: no raw lane stops at autoconf.h

P4 preprocessor: stray characters (backslash, @, backtick, $) are single pp-tokens kept by stringification; .5foo is a pp-number; E0112 at the C lexer for a pp-token with no C form (spec 10.4). Gate: no raw lane stops in sysreg.h

G2 (open 2026-08-27, 6 lanes at E2202 aggregate copy-init) remaining Day 7 debt: aggregate copy-initializer, flexible-array initializer, aggregate assignment and aggregate lvalue assignment, volatile-or-atomic update. Not yet opened; opened when telemetry reaches one or when C1 needs it, whichever first; lowering target: the new EvoIR copy instruction (spec 1.9.14); _Atomic stays E2702

R static relocation schema (spec 2.1 defers it): pointer-valued static initializers incl. addresses of file-scope compound literals, string literals and globals; not opened; needed by stage C1 and counted in receipts as E3026 until then

J parse closure (spec 1.9.17): empty external declaration (done); E2920, __auto_type refusals, E2922 (done); label addresses and goto * parse and fail closed in lowering with E3029; and the three C11 declaration forms of 10.1.18 that every remaining lane stops on: free specifier order after a record or enum specifier (16 lanes), a typedef naming a function type (10 lanes), _Static_assert in a member list (2 lanes). Gate: dual-oracle parse 16/16, or every remaining lane named with its root cause

K constant folding closure (spec 10.1.19): sizeof/_Alignof fold over expressions, sizeof(void) and sizeof of a function are 1, the conditional null-pointer-constant rule, and array bounds evaluated wherever written: zero is a valid GNU zero-length array, negative is E2923, non-constant is E2203 with one message. Gate: dual-oracle parse 16/16; the fold must give 4 == 4 for a constant operand of __is_constexpr and 4 == 1 for a non-constant one, checked against the oracles, not merely accepted
K2 (opened 2026-08-29 by measurement): __int128_t and __uint128_t as spellings of __int128 and unsigned __int128 (102 cohort uses, spec 10.1.19)

K3 (opened 2026-08-29 by measurement): anonymous member promotion in the designator-path resolver, shared by designated initializers and __builtin_offsetof (spec 10.1.6); ambiguity is E2906. 28 lanes across 14 units

K4 (opened 2026-08-29 by measurement): __typeof_unqual__ (spec 10.1.10), 4,797 cohort uses, 28 lanes across 14 units; top-level qualifiers and _Atomic removed, operand unevaluated, array element qualifiers kept (ORACLE_CONFLICT resolved by refusal), nothing surviving into EvoIR

L parser recovery soundness (found 2026-08-30 by the survey): after a declaration fails part way through a function body the symbol table rolls back a scope the parser still holds, and the next scope it opens is rejected. Reproducers: `int a[-1]; void f(void) { goto nowhere; } int b[-2];` and cohort units init-init-task, mm-mincore under `--survey`. Gate: those two units survey to a finding list instead of unavailable, and every existing first-error diagnostic is byte-identical before and after

M projected lvalue root reconstruction (spec 10.1.3, implementation defects): the first RED checkpoint showed that `(&h->head)->next`, `(&g.head)->next`, and `(*&g.head).next` were rejected as E2102 while direct forms were accepted; that subcase is fixed. The sealed ce5d7d2 publication proved it was not the measured cohort blocker: all 28 lanes across 14 units still stopped at `get_current()->flags` or `get_current()->nr_cpus_allowed`, while binding `get_current()` to a named pointer first was accepted. The sealed 3ff1efd publication removed all 28 `invalid-projected-lvalue` failures and exposed the remaining in-scope update form in 22 lanes: `*(&record_member) = compound_literal` is rejected as `invalid-update-operands` while direct aggregate assignment is accepted. The gate closes only when call-result-rooted, address-rooted, and immediate address/dereference scalar and aggregate places are accepted without weakening invalid-place diagnostics.

N frontier rulings (spec 1.9.22): attribute before a null statement only, preserved and applied to nothing (E2924 otherwise), 24 lanes / 221 cohort uses; __builtin_offsetof with a non-constant index as unchecked runtime arithmetic evaluated once and not an ICE, 2 lanes / 11 uses; __builtin_object_size never evaluating its operand and always answering unknown, 2 lanes / 42 uses

O statement-expression scope correction and typeof function types (spec 1.9.23): E2905 only outside a function definition, permitted inside typeof/sizeof/_Alignof including within a _Static_assert condition (26 lanes, kernel container_of); typeof of a function designator as a declaration specifier (2 lanes, EXPORT_SYMBOL); E2925 for an out-of-range __builtin_object_size mode

P5 (spec 1.9.24): null pointer constants convert to function pointer types in every conversion context (13 units at root, 83 sites); integer-cast address constants are address constants (1 unit at root, 42 sites); lowering of pointer static initializers stays E3026. Behind them, surveyed: 13 units carry a failing static assertion (E2911) — a wrong folded value, to be diagnosed not suppressed — then enumerator ranges (E1303, 6 units) and designators (E2906, 2 units)
P6 (spec 1.9.25): packed enumeration layout, 15 lanes / 123 cohort declarations; the packed+aligned enum combination refused (ORACLE_CONFLICT, zero cohort uses)

P7 parser throughput, two distinct items: (a) the reconnaissance measures a DEBUG binary against a 10s cap - measured: kernel-power-main 7.68s debug vs 1.14s release, so most timeout lanes are a measurement artifact; the harness moves to the release binary as an explicit measurement-config change recorded in the receipt, never a silent cap raise; (b) init-init-task parses in 20s RELEASE while a same-size unit takes 1.1s - a real superlinearity to profile and fix, gate: within 3x of the same-size unit

P8 (spec 1.9.26): __builtin_has_attribute answered from the attribute inventory (13 GCC lanes, 34 sites, nonstring only); __builtin_va_start/va_end/va_copy accepted at the front end, E2926 rules, lowering and interpreters fail closed E3030 (13 lanes per oracle); empty records sizeof 0. Gate: no lane stops on either builtin; every remaining lane named

P9 (spec 1.9.27): any pointer-typed expression roots a place - one resolver, no admitted-form list (10 units at a call-result root, 1 at a conditional root); __builtin_strlen as ICE on a literal and an ordinary call to the declared strlen otherwise (2 units). Gate: no lane stops on E2102 invalid-update-operands, invalid-projected-lvalue or __builtin_strlen; every remaining lane named

P10 (spec 1.9.28): void pointer arithmetic in update forms (4 units, bpfptr->kernel += val); 128-bit assignment targets (1 unit); enumerators outside int with widened underlying type (1 unit, PERF_TXN_ABORT_MASK); the __attribute spelling (1 unit). Plus one driver defect: a unit containing only _Static_assert reports E1001 expected-declaration because the empty-unit check fires; a unit with no declarations is valid. Gate: dual-oracle parse 16/16 or every remaining lane named

P11 (spec 1.9.29): character-pointer signedness conversion accepted (6 lanes, qstr.name); __builtin_frame_address front-end accepted, E3031 in lowering (4 lanes); signed shift wrap in the constant evaluator so 1 << 31 is an enumerator (2 lanes); void* difference E3032 in lowering; 128-bit execution E3033 in both interpreters and lowering. Gate: dual-oracle parse 16/16 or every remaining lane named

P12 (spec 1.9.30, implementation defects): declarator lists declaring several functions (6 lanes, 3 units, fs_param_type) and typeof of a dereferenced function pointer as a declaration specifier (4 lanes, 2 units, static-call). Behind them per survey: E2002 ordinary-identifier-redefinition and E2202 (1 unit each, 2 sites). Gate: dual-oracle parse 16/16 or every remaining lane named

P13 (spec 1.9.31): __typeof spelling (4 lanes, 2 units); declarations inside a typeof statement expression scoped to it including linkage declarations, and the redeclaration rule with E2002 defined as incompatible-redeclaration (2 lanes, 1 unit). Gate: dual-oracle parse 16/16 - stage F1 closes on this publication or every remaining lane is named

P14 (implementation defect, no specification change; 1.9.31 covers it): the parser panics at crates/evocc-parser/src/lib.rs:4287 when a parameter declared after another parameter has a typeof type whose operand contains a nested typeof - the outer typeof installs the earlier parameters as temporary shadow symbols and the nested typeof installs them again in the same scope. Minimal: `long f(int a, typeof(__builtin_types_compatible_p(typeof(0L), long)) len);`. 4 lanes, 2 units (mm-mprotect, mm-mincore syscall wrappers). Gate: dual-oracle parse 16/16 - stage F1 closes on this publication or every remaining lane is named. A panic on valid input is a stop, not a miscompilation, and is still a defect: the RED asserts acceptance and the absence of a panic

F3 full-configuration parse survey: enumerate every built C translation unit from the reference build command records (2944 units), replay each through the release front end in survey mode, measure only. No production edits, no spec edits inside the survey window; the deliverable is the ranked first-diagnostic class list with clean / diagnosed / unavailable / timeout / panic counts, published from sealed evidence.

T token locations and preprocessor conformance: (T1) every token carries spelling and expansion spans; the parser composes node spans from expansion spans by the total rule of 10.1.20 and never slices a source buffer with a span; (T2) whitespace flag and stringization per 10.4; (T3) rescanning continues into the outer token sequence per 10.4. RED first, declared failures: a same-file macro tag case and a header-macro tag case for T1 (both panic today), the p15 table for T2, the p16 table for T3. Acceptance-diff guard: the 16-unit dual-oracle parse lanes (oracle-preprocessed input) stay 32/32 clean byte-for-byte. Then the full-configuration survey is re-run measure-only with the same harness and published. No predictions of the new distribution.

U preprocessor conformance from the second survey: (U1) directives inside macro arguments per 10.4, E0113 for #pragma and any non-conditional directive other than #define/#undef; (U2) empty arguments and variadic forwarding per 10.4; (U3) enumeration: records built with the host compiler (scripts/ and other HOSTCC records) are host programs, excluded and counted like assembly. RED first from the p20/p20b/p20c and p18 tables. Then the full-configuration survey re-run measure-only and published.

V parser rules from the second survey: (V1) __func__ and __FUNCTION__, E2921 for __PRETTY_FUNCTION__ (10.1.17); (V2) labeled last statement of a statement expression (10.1.17); (V3) array parameter adjustment on one code path (10.1.18); (V4) pointer sign in conversions, every site (10.1.18); (V5) modifiable lvalue as one predicate (10.1.3); (V6) address constants through casts and nested aggregates (10.1.19). RED first from the p17, p19 and p21 forms, each rule with at least three forms. Acceptance-diff guard on the 16-unit lanes. Then the full-configuration survey re-run measure-only and published.

W parser rules from the third survey: (W1) array lvalue decay for members, flexible members and string literals (10.1.3); (W2) range designators and inferred bounds (10.1.12); (W3) function pointer and void * conversions in every site including the conditional operator (10.1.18); (W4) library builtins, va_* typing, GCC-only ctype builtins reproducing p28-table.out (10.1.14); (W5) _Pragma at every #pragma position, __inline/__restrict spellings, attributes between specifiers (10.1.18); (W6) integer constants cast to pointers and static array decay as address constants (10.1.19). RED first from p22-p28, each rule with at least three forms; the ctype tables as one test that diffs against p28-table.out. Acceptance-diff guard on the 16-unit lanes. Then the full-configuration survey re-run measure-only and published.

X residue of the fourth survey: (X1) the _Pragma operator processed after expansion and the whitespace flag of a substituted argument (10.4, p30); (X2) qualified void * to function pointer at every site (10.1.18, p29); (X3) conditional address constants (10.1.19 via 10.1.18, p29); (X4) &&label address constants and goto * accepted, lowering E3029 unchanged (p29); (X5) __builtin_memmove, __builtin_prefetch, __builtin_extract_return_addr (10.1.14, p29); (X6) kfifo_get/put projected lvalue: minimize to a standalone reproducer and report, fix only if a rule of 1.9.48 already covers it. RED first, acceptance-diff guard, survey re-run measure-only.
gate: Kernel parse/preprocess counts published by the script from sealed evidence. Process gate; no predicted number. Counts must be >= 1/16 dual-oracle parse and 0/16 raw preprocess.
order: A, B, then re-run reconnaissance; C in the order the refreshed first-error sites rank them: typeof + _Generic first (all 30 parse lanes), the rest by the next publication. The list is scope, not sequence.

rulings.genericSelection: 2026-08-25: _Generic added to C. It is C11, not GNU, but every parse lane stops on typeof(_Generic(...)); typeof alone moves nothing.
rulings.typeofGenericSlice: 2026-08-25: the architecture owner opened exactly the typeof + _Generic portion of C against the published 30-lane first-error site. Statement expressions, designated initializers, compound literals and all of D remain closed until a later publication ranks them.
rulings.builtinsFirst: 2026-08-25: E before the rest of C and before D. Roadmap places builtins on Day 16; the lead ruled that the only kernel number (parse) is stuck on them and moves E forward. Semantics beyond parse-level resolution (branch hints, optimizer-known constants) stay on Day 16.
rulings.asmParseLevel: 2026-08-25: asm is accepted and preserved with maximal effects; lowering stays fail-closed (E3021) until Section 4 specifies the operation (stage C1).
rulings.stageFUntilSixteen: 2026-08-26: stay on stage F until dual-oracle parse reads 16/16; windows G (core C debt), H (statement expressions, __auto_type, designated initializers, compound literals), I (compile-time builtins). Backend B1 does not start before F1 is green; its specification is written in parallel. F2 (predefined macros) runs on the lead's track.
rulings.preprocessorParallel: 2026-08-26: F2 runs as its own window (P) by the executing agent, parallel to G/H/I; the two tracks touch different crates.
rulings.parseClosure: 2026-08-28: window J closes stage F1. All 28 remaining lanes stop on the stray semicolon after a macro-expanded static inline function; the rest of J is the debt the aggregate-copy and builtin windows reported. Backend specification (B1 EvoMIR) starts when F1 is green.
rulings.computedGotoDeferred: 2026-08-28: no indirect-branch terminator is added. The cohort writes no goto *, and its only label address is cast to an integer, which ptrtoint already excludes; both forms parse and fail closed as E3029. The measurement that reopens this is a lane whose first error is E3029.
rulings.foldingIsFailDangerous: 2026-08-29: the conditional null-pointer-constant rule and the array-bound check are fail-dangerous, not fail-safe: a wrong answer is silent. Window K's acceptance is a measured value against the sealed oracles for each, never 'it parses'.
rulings.zeroLengthArrays: 2026-08-29: zero-length arrays are valid everywhere, measured in both oracles in every record position and at file scope. Revision 1.9.18 refused them unprobed; 1.9.19 corrects it. E2923 is negative bounds only.
rulings.recoveryFixMustNotChangeAcceptance: 2026-08-30: the first attempt at this reset the current scope to file scope after every external declaration. It removed the panic and silently turned a rejected construct (__typeof_unqual__ before it was implemented) into an accepted object. Any fix must be shown not to change what the compiler accepts: compare --parse-only output on all 16 cohort units before and after, byte for byte.
rulings.objectSizeAnswersUnknown: 2026-08-30: __builtin_object_size always answers unknown (SIZE_MAX for modes 0-1, 0 for modes 2-3) because this profile performs no object-size analysis. This differs from both oracles for objects they can see, and is recorded as a deliberate profile choice rather than an ORACLE_CONFLICT arbitration: claiming a size the compiler has not computed is the kind of unfounded assertion the profile refuses. No cohort use is in a constant context.
rulings.statementExpressionFolding: 2026-08-31: both oracles fold a statement expression with a constant result where a constant expression is required; this profile does not, and the context reports its own not-a-constant diagnostic. Deliberate deferral, counted rather than silent. Reopen if a lane's first error is that diagnostic.
rulings.timeoutMeasurementArtifact: 2026-09-01: 11 timeout lanes decompose into a debug-binary measurement artifact (harness fix, explicit) and one genuine 17x parser slowdown on init-init-task (performance defect, profiled and fixed, not tuned around).
rulings.placeRootsAreGeneral: 2026-09-01: the place resolver admits every pointer-typed expression as a root. Four windows refused four root forms one at a time (loaded pointer, address-of, call result, conditional); the fix is the general rule, not a fifth case.
rulings.stageF1Closed: 2026-09-02: stage F1 (dual-oracle parse 16/16) closed on sealed run 20260901T185119Z-83939, subject f509eb5, zero regressions. Independently confirmed by the architect: 32/32 lanes parse with no diagnostic at 81c6522. Next: F3 measure-only full-config survey (executor) and B1 EvoMIR specification (architect); scope R (static relocations), E3030/E3031/E3033 executions and asm lowering remain fail-closed debts for C1.
rulings.fullConfigSurveyIsMeasureOnly: 2026-09-02: the full-configuration survey answers the scale sub-question of the correctness bet: whether the frontier loop that converged at 16 units converges at ~2,500. It is measure-only. A panic, a timeout, or a crash on any unit is a finding recorded under its own class, never something to fix inside the survey window. Fixes come afterwards as ordinary scoped windows, ranked by the survey's own at-root counts.
rulings.selfImprovementRedLines: 2026-09-02: two red lines for optimizer self-improvement (the policy triple: ruleset, cost model, schedule). One: no rule enters the release ruleset without machine verification; differential testing alone is not verification. Two: the kernel cohort is the acceptance gate and never enters fitness; evolution corpora and acceptance corpora are physically separate, and receipts prove the separation by digest. Cost model and schedule are pre-verified search spaces (extraction picks only among proven-equivalent forms) and may be learned freely; the dynamic interpreter step count is the pre-backend fitness signal.
rulings.surveyMeasuredAnUnmeasuredPath: 2026-09-02: the full-configuration survey (run 20260902T023241Z-87371: 5 clean, 59 diagnosed, 2,768 panic of 2,832) exposed that the closed parse stage measured oracle-preprocessed input and that the raw-preprocess stage measured only the absence of diagnostics, not fidelity. The integrated path raw source -> EvoCPP -> parser had never been measured; 15 of the 16 cohort units panic on it. Root causes, all reproduced by the architect and settled by sealed probes: spelling-span composition and buffer slicing (2,768 units, one rule), stringization spacing (56 units), rescanning stopping at the replacement list (hidden behind the panics; every unit including linux/atomic.h). Rule: a stage closes only on the path its consumer uses, and a gate's label names the property it measures. Records corrected in the roadmap and README.
rulings.preprocessedTextIsNotAcceptance: 2026-09-02: -E output today writes tokens without separating white space or line breaks. It is a convenience surface until the whitespace flag of 10.4 lands; no acceptance number is computed from it, and the survey consumes the token stream.
rulings.secondSurveyRanking: 2026-09-02: run 20260902T051739Z-447 (subject 29cd779): 1,292 clean / 1,540 diagnosed / 0 panic of 2,832. The architect sub-classified every top class by the construct at the diagnosed position and reproduced each on a micro case: struct_group 562 units = directives inside macro arguments; __func__ 508; SYSCALL_DEFINEn about 50 = empty-argument variadic forwarding; pm_opp.h 64 = array parameter adjustment; SYSCTL_ZERO 54 = address constants through casts; ___wait_event 41 = labeled last statement; const-pointer members 40 = modifiable-lvalue predicate; DEFINE_CLASS 20 = pointer sign. Eight rules cover about 1,380 of the 1,540. Recorded and not yet ruled: kfifo_get projected lvalue (34; the cast-deref micro forms pass, the real form is still unminimized), designators E2906 (34), builtins __builtin_isdigit/memset/va_arg/alloca (17), __restrict (12), host-tool units under scripts/ (34, handled as enumeration in U3), __VA_OPT__ (1), E0102 (2), E0110 (1), E1006 (1), E2205 (2).
rulings.pragmaInsideMacroArgumentConflict: 2026-09-02: #pragma inside a macro argument is processed by GCC-14 and refused by Clang-19 (p20c). ORACLE_CONFLICT: E0113, take the refusal. Conditional directives and #define/#undef inside arguments are processed by both and are defined.
rulings.prettyFunctionConflict: 2026-09-02: __PRETTY_FUNCTION__ is spelled differently by the two oracles (p17: GCC-14 'main', Clang-19 'int main(void)'). ORACLE_CONFLICT: E2921. Only fs/ocfs2 uses it and the pinned configuration does not build it.
rulings.incompatiblePointerTypesConflict: 2026-09-02: GCC-14 refuses an incompatible pointer conversion (-Wincompatible-pointer-types is an error), Clang-19 warns (p21). ORACLE_CONFLICT resolved toward the refusal: E2202 stays. Pointer sign mismatch is a warning under both and is accepted.
rulings.singleLinePreprocessedParseTimeout: 2026-09-02: parsing the architect's own -E output of arch/arm64/kvm/config.c (one line, no line breaks) did not finish in 120 s while the raw path took at most 17.6 s per unit in the survey. Recorded as a measurement to repeat on a quiet machine before any ruling; the -E text is not an acceptance surface.
rulings.thirdSurveyRanking: 2026-09-02: run 20260902T113345Z-48715 (subject 2cf2b9e): 2,445 clean / 353 diagnosed / 0 panic of 2,798 target units (34 host-tool units excluded). Six rules reproduced on micro cases cover about 300 of the 353. Recorded and not ruled: kfifo_get (30 units; the architect's four micro forms with anonymous unions, zero-length arrays and typeof through the pointer all pass, so the real form is still unminimized), E0102 (2), E2205 (2), E0110 (1), E1005 (1), E1006 (1), __VA_OPT__ (1).
rulings.gccOnlyBuiltinsFollowTheProfile: 2026-09-02: __builtin_isdigit and the other ctype builtins exist in GCC-14 and not in Clang-19 (p26). This is not a semantic conflict: the kernel selects them through __has_builtin, which the target profile answers as GCC-14 does, so Clang never sees that branch. The semantics are taken from GCC-14 alone and pinned by the executed table p28-table.out.

processRules: One tests-only commit opens a red window; its failures come from declared missing constructs, never from a build error. No commit widens the declared set; each implementation commit narrows it; the last closes it.
No commit disables, deletes or ignores a test.
Format changes migrate the existing corpus in the same commit.

Review of specification revision 1.9 is one round, PASS or FAIL per section, due within one working day of request. If it does not arrive, the red window opens and review findings land as amendments to it.
